differences.native: LeetCode calls findNumber with no arguments and injects commonSetBits(num).
differences.app: solve receives the fixture's hidden n and constructs an explicit CommonSetBitsAPI callable before running the same thirty one-bit probes.
differences.rationale: The app must serialize the hidden value to reproduce an interactive judge locally. Each query returns exactly (n & num).bit_count(); bit order, masks, answer updates, result, and complexity match the Accepted algorithm.
